verdict.rationale: Together AI documents its own throughput and performance options. Dedicated endpoints on reserved hardware promise better performance with no hard rate limits. Provisioned throughput commits to throughput targets, autoscaling adds replicas, and SSE streaming is supported. One community user reports good speed. However, no evidence addresses time-to-first-token or latency figures specifically. missing for 10: documented TTFT/latency metrics or SLAs, benchmark or independent latency/throughput corroboration, explicit low-latency serving guidance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation
